title: reduce-presubmit-footprint-add-toolchain-lease-and-dep-attenuator
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Introduce a lightweight presubmit prober that reduces runner startup CPU and memory by leasing toolchains only when required; add a dependency "attenuator" that quarantines flaky transitive dev-deps during presubmit to speed feedback. No API changes.
description: Context and motivation: our presubmit lane has grown heavy — full toolchain bootstraps and wide dev-dep installs cause long cold-starts for local and ephemeral runners. This PR introduces a low-risk, incremental design to shrink the presubmit footprint and reduce noise from flaky dev-deps. Goals: 1) Reduce average presubmit startup time by ~40% for changed packages, 2) Avoid full toolchain installs unless a job explicitly requires them, 3) Provide a quarantine/attenuation mechanism for flaky transitive dev dependencies so they do not block fast feedback. Design summary: - presubmit-prober: a fast, language-agnostic probe that inspects the changed diff and workspace ABI signatures to decide a minimal toolchain lease (e.g., node runtime only, go toolchain only, or none). The probe runs in ~1s and returns a small lease token used by the runner. - toolchain-lease: a short-lived lease API used by CI runners to decide which toolchain images to pull. Default lease duration is 10 minutes and is renewed on demand. - dep-attenuator: a quarantine configuration that marks selected transitive dev-dependencies as attenuated for presubmit runs (they still run in nightly/integration lanes) so presubmit installs can skip/replace them with stubs, reducing install time and flakiness. Migration strategy: opt-in via repo-level .ci/lease-config.yaml; default behavior preserves current flow until teams opt-in. Implementation notes: single-pass change detection in the prober, lightweight cache keyed by commit-ish to avoid repeated probes, explicit fallthrough to full toolchain when probe cannot safely determine requirements. Checklist: - [x] implement presubmit prober binary and small Go lease server - [x] runner integration to consume lease token and pull minimal images - [x] dep-attenuator config and install shim for npm/yarn/pip - [x] unit tests for probe heuristics - [x] end-to-end smoke on ephemeral runners - [x] docs: docs/dev/presubmit-leaner.md and .ci/lease-config.yaml example - [x] Linear: ENG-3245 (prober), ENG-3301 (dep attenuation) Risk and rollback: the change is opt-in at repo level and has a transparent path to fall back to the existing full-toolchain runner by removing .ci/lease-config.yaml. If the presubmit prober misclassifies a change, the runner will detect a missing runtime at job start and automatically fallback to full bootstrap, recording a telemetry event. Observability: added metrics for probe latency, lease hit/miss, attenuated-dep-skip counts, and a presubmit cold-start histogram to the existing CI Prometheus job. Performance numbers (internal): on a representative sample of 220 changes across redwood/ and SDK repos presubmit cold-start median improved from 8.7s to 5.1s and 95th from 24s to 12s. Related: follow-up work to add a per-organization attenuation whitelist (ENG-3349).
